title: ALMA Observations of the Orion Proplyds
question: What are the dust disk masses of the Orion proplyds and other ONC stars, and how do they depend on distance from theta1 Ori C (external photoevaporation)?

what.value: VLA centimeter flux densities used for free-free extrapolation

evidence.quote: using published VLA flux densities from 1.3 cm to 6 cm (cite: garay; felli; felli93; zapata)

what.value: SMA disk masses at intermediate distances

evidence.loc: Disk Masses and Distance from theta1 Ori C
evidence.quote: including the previous SMA results from (cite: mann10) to fill in the intermediate distances not yet probed with ALMA

what.value: Positions and names of non-proplyd targets from HST ACS and CTIO surveys

evidence.quote: ACS sources from (cite: robberto), ROB sources from (cite: robberto10)

recipe.method: CASA CLEAN with MFS, Briggs robust 0.5, Clark, boxes, primary beam correction
Fit elliptical Gaussians in the image plane for centroids and integrated flux densities; noise from emission-free regions
Extrapolate maximum cm flux with F_ff ∝ nu^-0.1 to 856 um, subtract to get F_dust
key_parameters: cm data only at wavelengths <= 6 cm

assumptions: d=400 pc, kappa=0.034 cm2/g with gas-to-dust 100:1, T=20 K (40 K for massive stars)

recipe.method: Fraction of sources detectable at >=3 sigma vs disk mass
Censored-data correlation tests on ALMA plus SMA data

evidence.quote: We detected submillimeter emission from 21 of the 22 targeted *HST*-identified proplyds in this survey
the observed fields are 100% complete for $M_{\rm disk} \geq\,1.2\,M_{\rm jup}$

answer_key.quantity: Upper limits on undetected disk masses

evidence.quote: The ALMA observations place stringent (3 $\sigma$) upper limits of 0.1–0.6 $M_{\rm jup}$ on the disk masses for the undetected targets

answer_key.quantity: Probability of no correlation, mass vs projected distance

evidence.loc: Disk Masses and Distance from theta1 Ori C
evidence.quote: the probability of no correlation between disk mass and projected distance to $\theta^1$ Ori C is $<$10$^{-4}$ for all 3 tests

not_stated_but_needed: Exact CASA version and CLEAN parameters (niter, cell size, image size in pixels, box definitions)
Exact numerical RMS threshold used for CLEAN
Specific cm flux values and spectral index fits used for free-free extrapolation
Details of Gaussian fitting procedure for flux and sizes
Details of the survival analysis implementation (ASURV?) and the SMA data table
Whether the 3-sigma upper limit was computed from local or field-center rms
missing_for_reproduction: CASA version and exact CLEAN parameters
SMA data table and survival analysis details
score_reason: Data are public and the recipe is mostly described, but several processing parameters and the literature fluxes are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data; fluxes and masses in tables with a simple mass formula.
